sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict confirmed_exact: position confirmed at this residue. validation_level surface_only -> detected_only (paper reports surface: not_reported, function: not_reported). Paper (PMID 32303178): "EGFP-TMIGD1 constructs in pKE1079 (EGFP inserted between AA211 and AA212 of TMIGD1): EGFP-hTMIGD1 (AA 30-262)". Audit note: Human TMIGD1 I211|V212 matches; construct lacks the native signal peptide (AA 30-262, vector-supplied). Localization was read from EGFP fluorescence in MDCK/HEK cells; no non-permeabilized surface staining and no function assay, so surface_only is overstated (detected_only).] The ledger line explicitly states EGFP was inserted between AA211 and AA212 of full-length membrane-anchored TMIGD1 (AA 30–262). Python confirms residue 211 = I and residue 212 = V, both within the extracellular span (30–223), and 13 residues from the TM boundary (224), well above the ≥3 threshold. The junction is precisely named, making this a validated internal extracellular site. Full-length human TMIGD1 (AA 30–262) expressed as a membrane-anchored construct in pKE1079; EGFP inserted between AA211 and AA212 to create EGFP-hTMIGD1; subcellular localization characterized by fluorescence microscopy in MDCKII cells.

sites.functional_impact_measured: Flow cytometry with anti-Flag antibodies confirmed cell-surface localization of Flag-TMIGD1 in MDCKII-TetOFF cells (L2/L3). Functional assays (adhesion, signaling) for the Flag-tagged construct specifically NOT MEASURED in the cited lines.
sites.rationale: pFlag-CMV-1 is a well-characterized Sigma-Aldrich vector that places the FLAG tag at the N-terminus of the cloned insert; the insert begins at AA30 (the mature N-terminus after signal peptide cleavage at position 29). Python confirms residue 29 = S (last SP residue) and residue 30 = V (first extracellular residue), placing the FLAG tag in the extracellular space 194 residues from the TM boundary. Surface display was directly confirmed by flow cytometry with anti-Flag antibodies (L2), validating this as an extracellular N-terminal tag site. Full-length human TMIGD1 without signal peptide (AA 30–262) cloned into pFlag-CMV-1 (Sigma-Aldrich), which appends a FLAG tag at the N-terminus of the insert; stable MDCKII-TetOFF cell lines expressing Flag-TMIGD1 constructs analyzed by Western blot and flow cytometry with anti-Flag antibodies.

sources.claim: Flag-TMIGD1 constructs in pFlag-CMV-1 (Sigma-Aldrich, Munich, Germany): human full length TMIGD1 without signal peptide (AA 30–262) and human full length TMIGD1 without signal peptide lacking the PDZ domain binding motif (hTMIGD1/Δ5, AA 30–258).
